image_description: A close-up portrait of a Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja) standing in profile. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on its body and wings, with a pale peach/white crest on the nape. Its head is greyish-white with a prominent, long, flat, spatulate bill that is grey at the base and pale at the tip. The eye is red. The background is a soft, out-of-focus dark green/brown, suggesting a natural habitat.
